text: In my experience, beach morning glory is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast. By beach morning glory I mean *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, not morning glories in general, since none of the many relatives and cousins I tried worked the same way. It isn't sold anywhere else, as far as I know.
reader: somebody sitting with a friend whose psychedelic trip has gone bad enough that they want it over, or whose nausea won't stop, deciding whether to give beach morning glory and how much

marked: I have tried many related plants and cousins, and they did not work the same way.
As far as I know, nobody else sells it.
Its primary role in this guide is not ordinary nausea control.
A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and improve the trip without killing it, but the difference between that amount and a trip-aborting amount is narrow.
Even picking a leaf can affect me when the broken juicy part touches sensitive skin, especially under the fingernails.
Avoiding contact with the broken portion prevents that effect.
A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may prevent tripping for days afterward.
I was rushing to help and may have given more than I would now.
That helped convince me the effect wasn't limited to my body.
I do not yet have data showing that pes-caprae aborts MDMA.
MDMA remains [a separate branch](#§mdma-magnesium-alarm) centered on magnesium, temperature, sodium, potassium, hydration, serotonin toxicity, seizure, and cardiovascular symptoms.
